# OLV007 — Premium Olive Brine

> OLV007 is a double-filtered olive brine made from Greek Kalamata olives, built for the dirty martini. Montréal brand founded in 2023 by Peter Gianopoulos. Sold in 500 ml and 750 ml on Amazon.ca, through Cocktail Emporium and Wild Game Cooking, and to bars through Sysco Canada (item #7502663) and KAF (Toronto). Poured in 100+ bars and restaurants in Montréal and Toronto.

## Key facts
- Origin: Kalamata, Greece; double-filtered; low, controlled salt
- Dosage (2 oz martini): ¼ oz = Dirty, ⅓ oz = Extra Dirty; 75–100 martinis per 750 ml
- Shelf life: 2 years; refrigerate after opening
- Wholesale: info@olv007.com · +1 514-240-3225 (minimum 12 bottles for samples)
